ORDER :
This writ petition is filed declaring the action of the respondents No.1 to 4 in not filing the charge sheet which is mandatory under Section 173 Cr.P.C. in FIR No.113 of 2014 dated 25.11.2014 on the file of Therlam Police Station, as illegal and arbitrary.

sentences.text: Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home is present and has furnished a copy of instructions received from the Sub Inspector of Police, Therlam Police Station, stating that basing on the petitioner report, the Investigating Officer has registered the FIR in Crime No.113/2014 under Section 420 and 406 IPC and investigated and examined the witnesses.

After completion of investigation, the Investigating Officer addressed a letter to the Assistant Superintendent of Police,
Sub Division, Bobbili with a request to accord permission to refer the case as False.
After perusing the investigation lines and facts the Assistant Superintendent of Police, Sub-Division, Bobbili issued orders to refer the case as False vide C.No.253/Ref/ASP/Bobbili dated 15.09.2018.
Accordingly, the Investigating Officer referred the case as 'False'.

Later on 19.06.2019 in this case final report has been filed before Hon'ble Principal Junior Civil Judge-cum-Judicial First Class Magistrate Court,
Bobbilii vide DDR No.3374/2019.
4.

Bobbilii
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In view of the above, this Court observed that, the grievance of the petitioner has been redressed by the respondents concerned.
Hence, nothing survives in the present writ petition and the same is liable to be closed.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is closed.
6. As a sequel, interlocutory applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.

DR. K. MANMADHA RAO, J.
